scientific_integrity: Two independently specified graph representations and independent exhaustive cut and optimal-order enumerations agree. Every subset of the labelled graph is enumerated. Reproducible pure-Python verifiers are included.
scientific_limitations: A finite exact classification of the 18-vertex Pappus Levi graph only. It does not assert a theorem for other graphs. Earlier work supplies the general sigma-good/minimum-arrangement implication and a known scalar expansion ratio. Historical priority over unindexed tabulations remains uncertain.
title: Nested edge-isoperimetry and all optimal linear layouts of the Pappus graph
